symbols.read: The neutral-to-bearish read holds and the picture is essentially unchanged: price at 731.36 still sits above the 722.40 lower pivot, the 4H direction remains bearish, the combined 4H+1H signal stays at HOLD, and the 1H trend is still up with the last bar green (729.44→730.60). The SELL setup at 722.40 with stop 737.02 and target 686.36 is flagged invalidated, so the bearish trigger is not live despite the bearish 4H — bias stays neutral-to-bearish while price is capped below 737.02. The cushion under the pivot is still thin, limited to the older bull FVGs at 720.58–721.80 and 713.46–719.01, with no fresh FVGs beneath price. A close below 722.40 into that stack revives the bearish case toward 686.36, while reclaiming 737.02 flips the read back toward the 758.44 upper pivot.

Price is effectively unchanged at 82,104.49 versus the prior 82,103.14, so the neutral, slightly constructive bias holds: the 1H trend stays up and price remains above the 81,033.66 trigger, keeping the SELL setup invalidated. The key levels are unchanged — 81,033.66 as the downside trigger toward 77,715.32, and 84,352.00 as the level that would turn structure outright bullish. With no open FVGs, there is still no structural cushion beneath price, so a break of 81,033.66 would revive the bearish case. Bias: neutral leaning constructive while above 81,033.66; invalidation is a close below that level.

Price has reclaimed the 2,403.69 lower pivot at 2,413.99, so the prior neutral-to-bearish bias is revised to neutral-to-constructive; the 1H trend has flipped up (2,400.96→2,415.01, +0.59%) versus the previously flat reading, confirming the softening flagged last time rather than a fresh breakdown. The 4H remains bearish and the combined signal still reads HOLD with the SELL flagged INVALIDATED, so this is a pivot reclaim, not a confirmed trend reversal. With no open FVGs, the 2,354.54–2,370.66 support shelf is no longer an active draw, and the stale 2,227.50 target is effectively off the table while price holds above the pivot. Invalidation flips back bearish on a loss of 2,403.69, which would re-open the drift lower; the BULLISH regime tag now aligns better with the 1H upturn but still conflicts with the bearish 4H, so treat it as supportive noise until the 4H turns.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish and the prior read is confirmed, not revised: price has pushed further from 104.46 to 105.22, the 1H trend remains up, and the 107.16 short is still unarmed and invalidated. The structure has thinned slightly — the lower bull FVG at 101.33–102.09 is no longer listed, leaving only 102.17–103.39 as support beneath price. Key levels: 107.16 is the next upside test and the level that would re-arm the short setup, while a loss of 103.39 would weaken the bounce and a break below 102.17 would revive the bearish case. Invalidation of the bullish lean is a close back under the remaining FVG.

Price has edged up to 57.47 from 57.37, holding above the 57.29 prior 1H level with the 1H trend still up while the 4H remains bearish — combined signal stays HOLD, confirming rather than revising the prior neutral-to-bearish bias. The bullish FVG has widened to 57.004–57.34 and now sits directly beneath price as the nearest support, while the 57.42–57.53 bearish FVG continues to cap upside and is being tested right now. The 58.41 short entry remains expired and untriggered, with stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward the 61.45 upper pivot.

Price has dropped to 4,146.24 and is now pressing directly on the 4,141.44 lower pivot, a sharp reversal from the prior read's 4,184.84 that breaks the bullish 1H structure and flips the 1H trend down while the 4H turns bearish — the neutral-to-long bias is now void. The short setup from 4,141.44 with stop 4,148.48 and target 4,065.48 is the active structure, but the 1H bounce off the low (4,138.59→4,146.24) and the bull FVG at 4,131.485–4,138.095 sitting just below mean the pivot has not yet been decisively broken. A sustained break and close below 4,141.44 confirms the bearish continuation toward 4,065.48, while reclaiming 4,148.48 invalidates the short and puts the bear FVG at 4,155.445–4,158.805 back in play as resistance. Bias is bearish but unconfirmed until 4,141.44 gives way; the prior long thesis is dead.

Bias stays neutral-to-hold with a bullish lean, essentially unchanged from the prior read: price at 1.31 is still holding the reclaimed lower pivot, the 1H trend remains up (1.30→1.31), and the 4H is still bearish with the combined signal on HOLD. What changed is that the open bull FVG at 1.2764–1.2965 has been filled and removed, so that support cushion is gone and 1.31 is now the sole line in the sand. The SELL setup (entry 1.31, stop 1.37, target 1.20) is flagged invalidated, reinforcing that the downside path is negated while 1.43 stays the upside focus. Invalidation: a sustained break below 1.31 revives the bearish 4H case and reopens 1.20.
